request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Orbitail Gecko".

Creative brief
Name: Orbitail Gecko
Collection: Arcane Menagerie. Wild creatures altered by concentrated magic, with crystalline anatomy, runes, echoes, orbiting objects, and unusual projectile behavior.
Core concept: A wall-hugging skirmisher controlled by three orbiting tail fragments.
Body and silhouette: Low gecko with splayed feet, broad head, and a tail separated into floating segments.
Signature features: Three orbiting tail stones, glowing toe pads, and a spiral back rune.
Palette and materials: Deep teal, pale mint, muted magenta, and smooth crystal gray.
Movement personality: Quick, sticky, and sharply directional.
Attack concept: Tail segments orbit visibly before launching one by one toward the player, then slowly returning to reform the tail.
Directional details: The smallest fragment always orbits on the gecko’s left side.
Avoid: Chameleon eyes, realistic skin texture, tail fragments resembling random debris.
